[[Category:Justice system]]
A '''justice system''' is a formal system of institutions that ensures universal compliance to the [[law]].<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>

In many parts of the world, the justice system is '''public''', i.e., not owned or ran by any person or organisations except the government.

In other parts of the world, certain parts of the justice system may be delegated to private corporations (e.g, In the [[United States of America]], some prisons are ran by private companies).

== Components ==

A justice system consists of:

* [[mediation service]]s
* [[public prosecutor]]s
* [[courts of law]],
* [[executors of justice]].
